crossRefs.note: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language…
Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?
“Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says Yahweh, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many…
I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake…
They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be…

translations.web: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
translations.bsb: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
translations.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
translations.asv: Wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
